fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Scratch memory the game changes constantly while playing; not save data
fields.evidence: diff: changes on most play steps; not read by any load or check routine

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: diff of all tree saves

fields.name: signature 1
fields.meaning: Text FINAL FANTASY IV. If it or signature 2 is missing at power-on the whole chip is wiped to zero and both signatures plus a version tag are written again
fields.evidence: code 2000:2f30 (check) / 2000:2f69 (wipe and write); boot read by 2000:2f44

fields.name: palette backup
fields.meaning: Copy of the colour palettes, taken when the field menu opens and put back when it closes. Not covered by the checksum
fields.evidence: code 4000:0568 (copy palette RAM fe00 to here), 4000:05e9 (copy back)

fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Small scratch area cleared and used by the game during play; not part of any save copy
fields.evidence: code 4000:0602 clears 2210+16; diff during play

fields.name: save file 1
fields.meaning: Save file slot 1 (written at save points). Same layout as the 2055-byte game record described below for the suspend record
fields.evidence: code 2000:33ed (write, slot 0), 2000:3495 (load), 2000:3249 (file list); empty (all zero) in every state of this tree

fields.name: save file 2
fields.meaning: Save file slot 2, same layout
fields.evidence: code 2000:33ed slot 1 (base 2250 + 0x807 x slot)

fields.name: save file 3
fields.meaning: Save file slot 3, same layout
fields.evidence: code 2000:33ed slot 2

fields.name: save file 4
fields.meaning: Save file slot 4, same layout
fields.evidence: code 2000:33ed slot 3; the slot list shows 4 entries (2000:3249 loop of 4)

fields.name: suspend record (whole)
fields.meaning: The suspended game. Covers 426c-797b: the 2055-byte game record, then live field memory that the game keeps in the save chip, then a copy of field engine state. One checksum covers all of it
fields.evidence: code 2000:33ed with slot 4 (menu suspend option, called from 4000:4672); checksum 2000:346e; diff across suspend writes

fields.name: play time minutes
fields.meaning: Play time, minutes part (0-59)
fields.evidence: screen TIME 00:06 vs 00:07 matches byte 06 vs 07 across two suspends; code 5000:0187 adds one every 4500 frames (one minute)

fields.name: play time hours
fields.meaning: Play time, hours part (stops at 99)
fields.evidence: code 5000:018e (cap 0x63); file list prints it before the minutes (2000:3383)

fields.name: party formation
fields.meaning: Which character stands in each of the 5 battle positions (character number, or ff = empty). The save-file list shows the name, level and HP of the character in position 0
fields.evidence: code 2000:55fa (remove from party clears the matching entry); new game 2000:31f1 sets ff ff 00 ff ff; file list 2000:32c5 uses entry 0

fields.name: game-start values
fields.meaning: Values set when a new game starts (00 0c 00 0a 00 03 03 02 00 09 01); meaning not identified; byte +0xa is passed to a helper at load (2000:34c3)
fields.evidence: code 2000:320a..322f (new game); same in both suspends

fields.name: character records
fields.meaning: 12 character records of 69 bytes each (one per playable character, by character number)
fields.evidence: code 2000:3052 builds them at new game; 2000:3249 file list reads level and HP from them

fields.name: character names
fields.meaning: 13 names of 8 bytes; each name is a font-page byte (02) then character codes, ended by ff. The code-to-glyph mapping is not decoded, so names are kept as raw codes
fields.evidence: code 2000:2fd0 (new game copies names), 2000:32d0 (file list prints name); first name = 02 7e 7c 99 (Cecil)

fields.name: leader position
fields.meaning: Which battle position is the party leader shown on the map
fields.evidence: code 2000:54eb (picks first filled position); new game 2000:31ec = 2

fields.name: leader character
fields.meaning: Character number of the map leader
fields.evidence: code 2000:323f and 4000:0614 store it from 2000:54eb

fields.name: spell lists
fields.meaning: Lists of learned spells per spell set (lists of spell numbers, 0 = empty). Shows runs 01..18 and 19..35 in natural saves
fields.evidence: content only; no code read yet

fields.name: inventory
fields.meaning: Item list, 128 entries of item number and count; new game puts fe/ff marker entries in the first two
fields.evidence: code 2000:31df (new game writes fe 00 ff 00); suspends show the markers only

fields.name: map number
fields.meaning: Map the party is on
fields.evidence: code 4000:054e copies it from the field map number when the menu opens; 4000:34cc restores it on load

fields.name: travel mode
fields.meaning: How the party travels (new game = 1 walking; other values for vehicles). Reads 0 in the ship-interior suspends
fields.evidence: code 2000:3234 new game = 1; 5000:2bdd sets other values; suspends hold 00 00

fields.name: map position
fields.meaning: Party x then y tile position on the map
fields.evidence: code 4000:0530..054b (pixel position >> 4 from the field object); suspend = 14 0a

fields.name: map return data
fields.meaning: Values near the position that the field code reads and writes (previous map / vehicle positions); not identified

fields.name: facing
fields.meaning: Direction the leader faces
fields.evidence: code 4000:0545 (from field object byte 103c); 4000:34d8 restores it

fields.name: other progress data
fields.meaning: Remaining record bytes (counters, vehicle data, flags) not identified
fields.evidence: some bytes non-zero in suspends

fields.name: random seed
fields.meaning: Index into the game's random number table; seeded from the frame counter at new game and at load
fields.evidence: code 2000:3242 (new game), 4000:4401 (load adds the frame counter), 2000:4f8a (random table read)

fields.name: gil
fields.meaning: Money, capped at 9,999,999
fields.evidence: code 2000:5621 (add and cap); suspends show 0 gil and hold 00 00 00 00

fields.name: event flags
fields.meaning: Story and event flags, one bit each, flag n at byte n/8 (runs to the end of the record)
fields.evidence: code 4000:9b19/9b3d/9b5e (set, clear, test bit n at 2382+n/8)

fields.name: current map tiles
fields.meaning: Tile layers of the map the party is on. The game builds and changes them here in the save chip while playing (for example when a door or chest changes); not copied by the save routine but covered by the suspend checksum
fields.evidence: code 7000:0362 (map load copies layers here), 5000:2845 (tile change); diffs on map changes

fields.name: system flags 1
fields.meaning: Copy of a game-wide flags word, put back on resume
fields.evidence: code 2000:3447 (write), 4000:495a (resume read)

fields.name: system flags 2
fields.meaning: Copy of a second flags word, put back on resume
fields.evidence: code 2000:344e (write), 4000:4961 (resume read)

fields.name: screen effect counters
fields.meaning: Copy of small blink and colour counters. Written at suspend, but the resume code reads these bytes from main memory instead of the save chip, so they are not really restored
fields.evidence: code 2000:3455 (write from RAM 2706); 4000:4968..497d read DS:6a1b with DS=0 (main memory); diff between suspends changed

fields.name: field object backup
fields.meaning: Copy of the field engine's object table (party sprite, people and objects on the map: position, facing), taken when the field menu opens and put back when it closes; included in the suspend checksum
fields.evidence: code 4000:0559 (copy RAM 1000-1b92 here), 4000:05c1 and 7000:0267 (copy back); diffs when the menu opens

fields.name: field engine state
fields.meaning: Copy of a field engine state block (RAM 2724-2ae9), written at suspend and copied back on resume; contents not identified
fields.evidence: code 2000:3438 (write), 4000:4985 (resume read), 2000:6fe7/701e (temporary copy)

fields.name: save file checksums
fields.meaning: One checksum per save file (4 x 4 bytes): 32-bit sum of all 2055 bytes of that file. 00000000 = empty; set to ffffffff at power-on if it does not match
fields.evidence: code 2000:3407 (write), 2000:3540 (check and invalidate); zero in all states (no file save made)

fields.name: suspend checksum
fields.meaning: 32-bit sum of every byte 426c-797b. Zero = no suspended game; set to ffffffff at power-on if it does not match; cleared to zero when the game is resumed (one resume per suspend). Loading a file also clears it
fields.evidence: recomputed on 7 natural saves (two distinct suspends 0x0000d616, 0x0000d870, both match); code 2000:346e (write), 2000:3599 (check), 4000:49a2 (resume clears), 4000:440c (load clears), diff on resume

fields.name: last save file
fields.meaning: Number of the save file last written or loaded (0-3); not changed by suspend

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in all states
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: temporary copy flag
fields.meaning: Set to 1 when the game makes a temporary copy of the record and field state into the suspend area without a checksum (restored by a later routine)
fields.evidence: code 2000:6ff6 (set), 2000:700a (test and restore, called from 4000:4d5e)

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: version tag
fields.meaning: Text 0129 plus a zero byte, written when the chip is formatted; not checked

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Zero
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: signature 2
fields.meaning: Text 2001SQUARE/STING; checked together with signature 1
fields.evidence: code 2000:2f4a; boot read 2000:2f59

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Zero
fields.evidence: diff

fields.name: console internal memory
fields.meaning: The console's own memory (owner name, birthday) is not used by the game: identical across boot and all suspends
fields.evidence: diff of .ieep files
